sentences.text: Marvel 's Inhumans , or simply Inhumans , is an upcoming American television series developed for ABC , based on the Marvel Comics race of the same name .	Inhumans	Inhumans	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	the same name	Inhumans

It is set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe -LRB- MCU -RRB- , sharing continuity with the films and other television series of the franchise .	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Marvel Cinematic Universe	the films	List of Marvel Cinematic Universe films	television series of the franchise	List of Marvel Cinematic Universe television series

The series is produced by ABC Studios and Marvel Television , with IMAX Corporation as a financing partner and Scott Buck serving as showrunner .	Scott Buck	Scott Buck	ABC Studios	ABC Studios	Marvel Television	Marvel Television	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	IMAX	IMAX	IMAX Corporation	IMAX Corporation	showrunner	showrunner

The series is centered around Black Bolt , with Anson Mount in the role , and other members of the Inhuman Royal Family .	Anson Mount	Anson Mount	Black Bolt	Black Bolt	Inhuman Royal Family	List of Inhumans#Inhuman Royal Family

A film from Marvel Studios based on the Inhumans began development in 2011 , before being announced in October 2014 for a November 2018 release as part of their Phase Three slate of films .	Inhumans	Inhumans	Marvel Studios	Marvel Studios	Phase Three slate of films	List of Marvel Cinematic Universe films#Phase Three

The species was first introduced to the MCU in the second season of Marvel 's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. , and the film was subsequently removed from Marvel Studios ' release schedule in April 2016 .	Marvel Studios	Marvel Studios	second season	Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. (season 2)
Inhumans was announced in November , to be partly filmed on IMAX digital cameras and to be the first live-action television series to debut on IMAX screens .	Inhumans	Inhumans	IMAX	IMAX
Buck joined the series the next month .

Mount was cast in February 2017 , with Iwan Rheon , Serinda Swan , Eme Ikwuakor , Isabelle Cornish , Ken Leung , Ellen Woglom , Sonya Balmores , and Mike Moh also starring in the series .	Iwan Rheon	Iwan Rheon	Serinda Swan	Serinda Swan	Eme Ikwuakor	Eme Ikwuakor	Isabelle Cornish	Isabelle Cornish	Ken Leung	Ken Leung	Ellen Woglom	Ellen Woglom	Sonya Balmores	Sonya Balmores	Mike Moh	Mike Moh
Filming began in March 2017 , at the former Naval Air Station Barbers Point airfield in Kalaeloa , Hawaii .	Naval Air Station Barbers Point	Naval Air Station Barbers Point

Inhumans is set to debut on IMAX screens on September 1 , 2017 , and run for two weeks , before premiering on ABC on September 22 , and airing eight episodes .	Inhumans	Inhumans	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	IMAX	IMAX
